limits: System RAM includes the operating system and other board processes; this is not estimator peak RSS.
Sampling cannot prove all between-sample peaks or absence of throttling.
Dynamic CPU frequencies and temperature samples do not prove a fixed power profile or no thermal/power throttling.
The trial overlapped explicitly recorded host-only diagnostic jobs; it is not an exclusive clean-room performance benchmark.

coordinator_lifetime_memory_snapshot_aft.scope: Whole coordinator cgroup lifetime includes earlier pilot reviews and full-lake analysis/CPU plotting, not an isolated per-stage RSS benchmark.
